title: medmem-law: memorization control law for medical image diffusion models
description: Experiment code and every measured artifact behind the control law M(N, E) for diffusion models trained on public medical image datasets: the calibrated memorization metric (whitened-feature nearest neighbour, tau anchored at FPR = 0.5%, plus an independent implementation of the pixel-space criterion of Bonnaire et al. 2025), six candidate laws with censoring-aware fitting, leave-one-N-out validation with a pooled R2, four stopping policies evaluated per run, and the full audit trail (one CSV row per measurement point, a SHA256 manifest of every controlled file, and an independent R re-implementation of the fit). The paper's central claim is deliberately negative about the control law and positive about the closed-loop controller; see docs/HANDOFF.md.
notes: Numbers in any manuscript citing this archive must match results/ at the tagged commit; docs/SUPPLEMENT.md maps every claim to the file and filter that produces it.
